data.one_liner: Myket In-App Purchase plugin for Android applications.
data.what_it_does: Integrates Myket In-App Billing into Android apps, enabling initialization, inventory and SKU queries, secure purchases, and handling consumable/non-consumable items.
use_when: You need to integrate in-app purchases via the Myket Android store.
Your app targets Android users who rely on the Myket store for payments.
avoid_when: Your app targets iOS or other stores without Myket support.
You only need standard Google Play billing (use in_app_purchase instead).
strengths: Full in-app billing support for Myket.
weaknesses: Requires manual native setup of Maven repository and manifest placeholders.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding Myket's Maven repository in settings.gradle.kts/build.gradle and configuring manifest placeholders in build.gradle.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Flutter plugin for in-app purchases, primarily supporting Google Play and App Store.
